figs.name: plc-scan-cycle-input-output-image-table-diagram
figs.alt: plc scan cycle diagram with input image table, program logic and output image table
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing how a PLC copies start button I0.0 into the input image table, solves the logic and writes Q0.0 to run the conveyor motor.
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 540" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>PLC input image table, program and output image table with field devices</title>
<rect width="800" height="540" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#1e3a8a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">PLC Input and Output Image Tables</text>
<rect x="330" y="50" width="450" height="402" rx="14" fill="#f8fafc" stroke="#2563eb" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-dasharray="8 6"/>
<rect x="20" y="65" width="200" height="90" rx="10" fill="#fff7e6" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="120.0" y="92.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Field input</text>
<text x="120.0" y="115.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Start button</text>
<text x="120.0" y="138.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">I0.0 pressed</text>
<rect x="360" y="65" width="390" height="90" rx="10" fill="#eff6ff" stroke="#2563eb" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="555.0" y="104.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Input image table</text>
<text x="555.0" y="128.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">I0.0 = 1</text>
<rect x="360" y="195" width="390" height="90" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#2563eb" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="555.0" y="222.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Program execution</text>
<text x="555.0" y="245.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">If I0.0 = 1 then Q0.0 = 1</text>
<text x="555.0" y="268.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">top to bottom, left to right</text>
<rect x="360" y="325" width="390" height="90" rx="10" fill="#eff6ff" stroke="#2563eb" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="555.0" y="364.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Output image table</text>
<text x="555.0" y="388.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Q0.0 = 1</text>
<rect x="20" y="325" width="200" height="90" rx="10" fill="#fff7e6" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="120.0" y="352.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Field output</text>
<text x="120.0" y="375.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Conveyor motor</text>
<text x="120.0" y="398.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Q0.0 = 1, runs</text>
<line x1="222" y1="110" x2="357" y2="110" stroke="#1e3a8a" stroke-width="3" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="289" y="98" font-size="17" fill="#1e3a8a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Input scan</text>
<line x1="555" y1="157" x2="555" y2="193" stroke="#1e3a8a" stroke-width="3" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="570" y="181" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">logic reads I0.0</text>
<line x1="555" y1="287" x2="555" y2="323" stroke="#1e3a8a" stroke-width="3" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="570" y="311" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">result stored in Q0.0</text>
<line x1="357" y1="370" x2="223" y2="370" stroke="#1e3a8a" stroke-width="3" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="289" y="358" font-size="17" fill="#1e3a8a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Output scan</text>
<text x="555" y="442" font-size="18" fill="#2563eb" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">PLC CPU memory</text>
<text x="400" y="488" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Logic works on stored copies, not on live inputs and outputs.</text>
<text x="400" y="518" font-size="18" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Housekeeping runs between program execution and output scan.</text>
</svg>

figs.name: plc-scan-cycle-four-steps-flowchart
figs.alt: flowchart of PLC scan steps input scan, program execution, housekeeping and output scan
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing the four repeating steps of a PLC scan: input scan, program execution, communication and housekeeping, and output scan, taking 1 to 50 ms.
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 560" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>PLC scan cycle flowchart with four repeating steps</title>
<rect width="800" height="560" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#1e3a8a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">PLC Scan Cycle: 4 Steps in a Loop</text>
<rect x="160" y="65" width="440" height="75" rx="10" fill="#eff6ff" stroke="#2563eb" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="380.0" y="96.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">1. Input scan</text>
<text x="380.0" y="119.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">inputs copied to input image table</text>
<line x1="380" y1="140" x2="380" y2="173" stroke="#1e3a8a" stroke-width="3" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="160" y="175" width="440" height="75" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#2563eb" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="380.0" y="206.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">2. Program execution</text>
<text x="380.0" y="229.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">logic solved, results to output image</text>
<line x1="380" y1="250" x2="380" y2="283" stroke="#1e3a8a" stroke-width="3" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="160" y="285" width="440" height="75" rx="10" fill="#eff6ff" stroke="#2563eb" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="380.0" y="316.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">3. Communication and housekeeping</text>
<text x="380.0" y="339.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">HMI, SCADA, diagnostics, timers, PID</text>
<line x1="380" y1="360" x2="380" y2="393" stroke="#1e3a8a" stroke-width="3" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="160" y="395" width="440" height="75" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#2563eb" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="380.0" y="426.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">4. Output scan</text>
<text x="380.0" y="449.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">output image drives relays, solenoids</text>
<polyline points="380,470 380,500 100,500 100,102 157,102" fill="none" stroke="#2563eb" stroke-width="3" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="90" y="300" font-size="18" fill="#1e3a8a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="end">Repeat</text>
<line x1="650" y1="68" x2="650" y2="467" stroke="#4b5563" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#ah)" marker-start="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="720" y="255" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">One scan</text>
<text x="720" y="282" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">1 to 50 ms</text>
<text x="400" y="540" font-size="18" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">The PLC starts the next scan immediately after the output scan.</text>
</svg>

figs.name: plc-scan-cycle-scan-time-pulse-timing-chart
figs.alt: timing chart showing a 5 ms sensor pulse missed by a 10 ms PLC scan time
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing why scan time matters: inputs are read once per 10 ms scan, so a 5 ms sensor pulse between two reads is missed.
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 520" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Timing chart of a 5 ms sensor pulse missed by a 10 ms PLC scan</title>
<rect width="800" height="520" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#1e3a8a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Why Scan Time Matters: A 5 ms Pulse Is Missed</text>
<rect x="80" y="75" width="160" height="50" rx="0" fill="#eff6ff" stroke="#2563eb" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="160" y="107" font-size="18" fill="#1e3a8a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Scan 1</text>
<rect x="240" y="75" width="160" height="50" rx="0" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#2563eb" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="320" y="107" font-size="18" fill="#1e3a8a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Scan 2</text>
<rect x="400" y="75" width="160" height="50" rx="0" fill="#eff6ff" stroke="#2563eb" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="480" y="107" font-size="18" fill="#1e3a8a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Scan 3</text>
<rect x="560" y="75" width="160" height="50" rx="0" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#2563eb" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="640" y="107" font-size="18" fill="#1e3a8a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Scan 4</text>
<line x1="80" y1="125" x2="80" y2="336" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="6 5"/>
<line x1="240" y1="125" x2="240" y2="336" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="6 5"/>
<line x1="400" y1="125" x2="400" y2="336" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="6 5"/>
<line x1="560" y1="125" x2="560" y2="336" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="6 5"/>
<line x1="720" y1="125" x2="720" y2="336" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="6 5"/>
<text x="90" y="178" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Sensor signal</text>
<polyline points="80,260 272,260 272,205 352,205 352,260 720,260" fill="none" stroke="#2563eb" stroke-width="4"/>
<text x="312.0" y="195" font-size="18" fill="#1e3a8a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">5 ms pulse</text>
<text x="90" y="310" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Input image bit</text>
<line x1="80" y1="340" x2="720" y2="340" stroke="#4b5563" stroke-width="4"/>
<text x="400" y="366" font-size="18" fill="#dc2626" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Input image bit stays 0, so the pulse is missed</text>
<line x1="80" y1="395" x2="720" y2="395" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<line x1="80" y1="395" x2="80" y2="405" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="80" y="427" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">0 ms</text>
<line x1="240" y1="395" x2="240" y2="405" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="240" y="427" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">10 ms</text>
<line x1="400" y1="395" x2="400" y2="405" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400" y="427" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">20 ms</text>
<line x1="560" y1="395" x2="560" y2="405" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="560" y="427" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">30 ms</text>
<line x1="720" y1="395" x2="720" y2="405" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="720" y="427" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">40 ms</text>
<text x="400" y="465" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Red dashed lines: input read once per scan, scan time 10 ms</text>
<text x="400" y="500" font-size="18" fill="#1e3a8a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Fix: use a high speed input or an interrupt routine</text>
</svg>
